blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – United States President Donald Trump will visit Manila next month to attend the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Meetings. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro confirmed the planned visit but did not provide further details. READ: Marcos in Cebu for DOLE launch of worker assistance programs The White House also announced Trump’s upcoming trip to the Philippines before his visit to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen. The ASEAN Summit is scheduled for Nov. 15 to 17, while the APEC Summit in China will run from Nov. 18 to 19. […]... Keep on reading: Trump to visit Manila for ASEAN Summit in November
